description: This file contains unit tests for the PasswordStrengthService class, part of the Authentication Service in the OrangeHRM system. It tests password policy checking, validation, logging, and related functionalities.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the PasswordStrengthService functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates PasswordStrengthService, and populates test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEnforcePasswordDao
methods.description: Verifies that getEnforcePasswordDao returns an instance of EnforcePasswordDao.

methods.name: testCheckPasswordPolicies
methods.description: Checks password policy enforcement messages based on different user credentials.

methods.name: testIsValidPassword
methods.description: Tests the password validation logic for different password inputs and complexity levels.

methods.name: testLogPasswordEnforceRequest
methods.description: Tests logging of password enforce requests with mock user roles.

methods.name: testValidateUrl
methods.description: Ensures that URL validation logic returns true for the expected code.

methods.name: testGetUserNameByResetCode
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of usernames based on reset codes.

methods.name: testSaveEnforcedPassword
methods.description: Checks saving enforced passwords for existing users with different credentials.
